title: TemCompanion: An Open-Source Multi-Platform GUI Program for TEM Image Processing and Analysis
content: Image processing is essential for fully exploiting the capabilities of transmission electron microscopy (TEM), allowing researchers to effectively analyze, manipulate, and interpret their data. Typically, TEM images are acquired and saved using vendor software such as FEI TIA, Velox, and Gatan DigitalMicrograph. These proprietary programs often come with certain limitations. First, the data are saved in specialized formats that are not easily read by other software, complicating data exchange. Additionally, these programs are either not freely available (e.g., TIA and Velox) or have limited functionality (e.g., the free version of DigitalMicrograph). Most vendor programs are only available for the Windows platform, potentially restricting accessibility for researchers using other operating systems. While Python libraries such as HyperSpy [1] and pycroscopy [2] offer robust tools for TEM image processing, they usually require a significant level of programming expertise, which can be a barrier for users not proficient in coding.
